property_summary: For any play() call, the contract's balance after the call is either balanceBefore + TICKET_AMOUNT (no payout) or balanceBefore + TICKET_AMOUNT - FEE_AMOUNT - (potBefore + TICKET_AMOUNT - FEE_AMOUNT) = balanceBefore - potBefore (payout), and reverts only when the sent value is not exactly TICKET_AMOUNT.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `play(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
